title: When the server answers with an error (not a lost connection), the desk keeps showing old records with no warning
what: Every few seconds the panel asks the server for what other desks and members saved. If that ask fails for any reason other than no internet (a server error, a broken update), the failure is thrown away: no offline bar, no message, no log line. The desk keeps working on the last copy it had, so new payments from another desk, new self-join requests waiting for Approve on Today (including ones the member already paid online), and other changes simply do not appear. Only Enquiries shows a growing 'Updated N s ago'. The code comment says 'the bar says so', but the bar only turns on for a lost connection.
expected: Any failed refresh is written to the log, and after a couple of failures in a row the desk sees a plain line such as 'Could not get the latest updates. What you see may be old.'
how_often: only while the server is failing (rare), but then on every screen until reload
fix_line: Log the failed refresh and show a 'may be out of date' line after repeated failures

evidence: data:9 all-no catch rows of panel/brand-shell in _sources/silent.csv, all read
data:_sources/silent.csv holds 88 catch rows for panel/brand-shell
data:filtered by script, 79 rows, not read; 0 fallback rows listed
